summary: This informational document registers media types used by the Cloud Data Management Interface, a cloud storage interface from the Storage Networking Industry Association. The types name the kinds of objects it works with, such as objects, containers, domains, capabilities, and queues. It is not a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A cloud storage system handles different kinds of things, like files and folders. This document gives each kind an official label so programs know what they are receiving.

questions: cloud data management interface media types
